comments.author: Igor
comments.body:
R10 is the max rank for a skill that is not favored for the job your in.
R15 is the max rank for a skill that is favored for the job your in.
R16 is the max rank for a skill that is expert for the job your in.

So to increase your base cooking rank higher than 10 you need to change to a job where cooking is favoured or expert.

comments.author: DPiano
comments.body:
Statements about cooking and fire are false. Fire is not caused by low rank cooking, it is totally random and it's chance of happening is determined by 3 factors:

1. Sheer luck/random: You can be anywhere, anytime under any circumstances and ALWAYS you have a small % of your ship getting a fire, in some map areas (like cape of good hope) is more likely to get a fire.

2. Trade goods: Some goods are more likely to burn than others. Trade goods like spice, berries, and paper lanterns, among others, are prone to catch fire while sailing or sitting outside a port or at sea.

3. Sailor's skill: Sailors with low skill are likely to burn your ship, highly skilled sailors (max skill: 100 point) will never produce a fire on your ship.

Chances of reducing a fire can be cut above 90% if some conditions are meet but it's total prevention its imposible. Having sailors skilled with 100 points and having active aides' fire prevention skill (with aide store keeper trait 100) will help a lot but that doesn't make your ship immune to fire; you always will have a small chance of getting a fire.
